استبقيت (form X)
# اِسْتَبْقَيْتُ (istabqaytu) /is.tab.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اِسْتَبْقَيْتَ (istabqayta) /is.tab.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اِسْتَبْقَيْتِ (istabqayti) /is.tab.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اُسْتُبْقِيتُ (ustubqītu) /us.tub.qiː.tu/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
